metrics.unavailable_reason: The session collaboration interface does not expose native per-thread token/billing/context telemetry. Values are not inferred from duration or tool counts.

limitations: Shared host, instructional isolation and capacity delays limit causal comparison. The edit/update path remains unverified after an original control-locator timeout. The settled dialog capture was not personally viewed. Horizontal attachment navigation and truncated labels are retained tradeoffs. Recorded close exceeded the conservative bound by 3.294 seconds. Hardware keyboard/IME, touch, assistive technology, other engines, natural-time playback and device performance remain unverified; task localization is bounded. Native role/model/usage/cost telemetry remains unavailable. Independent acceptance is separate.
